name: West Virginia Manufacturing Solutions
old_description: "We’ve partnered with WVMS for years, and they’ve consistently delivered high-quality components for our industrial equipment. Their precision machining and attention to detail are second to none. Every project is completed on time and exceeds our expectations."
about:
West Virginia Manufacturing Solutions, Inc. (WVMS) was incorporated in 2004 in Montgomery, West Virginia, where it operates from a facility on Morris Drive. The company provides precision CNC machining and fabrication services to industrial clients across multiple sectors.

WVMS functions as a contract manufacturer and job shop offering multi-axis CNC turning up to 28-inch diameter, horizontal and vertical milling, laser cutting, welding, metal forming, bending, and assembly. In-house finishing includes heat treating, powder coating, and deburring. The shop also delivers prototyping, reverse engineering, and maintenance and repair services for engines, prime movers, and turbochargers.

The company serves the oil and gas, renewable energy, power generation, automotive, aerospace, medical, mining, chemical, industrial manufacturing, marine, and hydroelectric sectors. Customers include industrial equipment manufacturers, renewable energy project developers, automotive and aerospace suppliers, and mining and marine operators requiring durable components for extreme conditions.

WVMS emphasizes its skilled engineering team, comprehensive in-house capabilities from machining through finishing, and a customer-centric approach that prioritizes urgency and reliability to minimize downtime for critical industrial systems. The firm highlights global shipping reach and a commitment to quality assurance on every project.
